articles.summary: In less than seven months since its last funding round, Profound, an AI-powered e-commerce company, has raised $180 million in a Series D funding round, valuing the company at $1.8 billion.
points: Profound'ran a Series D funding round, raising $180 million.
The funding valuation of Profound reached $1.8 billion.
The fundraising occurred just seven months after the company's last round.
articles.insight: Profound's rapid progression through funding rounds within a seven-month span indicates the growing confidence in AI-driven e-commerce, which could lead to more rapid innovation and growth in the industry.

articles.title: Wonder scores a $425 million partnership with DoorDash as it builds its food empire
articles.description: Founded by veteran e-commerce entrepreneur Marc Lore, Wonder is slowly building a massive portfolio of restaurants and delivery companies.
articles.summary: Wonder has partnered with DoorDash for $425 million, aiming to expand its restaurant and delivery business. The deal, led by founder Marc Lore, is expected to strengthen Wonder's position in the food delivery sector.
points: Wonder, founded by e-commerce veteran Marc Lore, has partnered with DoorDash for a $425 million deal to expand its portfolio.
The partnership involves managing restaurant concepts and delivery operations, including contracting independent restaurants for delivery.
The deal is subject to regulatory approval, with a potential signing date of December 2022.
articles.insight: This partnership could establish Wonder as a leading player in the food delivery industry, leveraging DoorDash'selite brand to grow Wonder's portfolio and gain market share.

articles.title: India ends free ride for larger transactions on its ubiquitous digital payments network
articles.description: India will impose a 0.4% merchant fee on certain payments made through UPI starting October 15.
articles.summary: India will implement a 0demerchant fee of 0.4% for certain payments made via UPI starting from October 15. This move will affect a portion of the transactions made through the country's widely used digital payments network.
points: India imposes a 0.4% merchant fee on specific UPI transactions starting October 15.
This fee will apply to transactions exceeding ₹5,000 on the UPI network.
Transactions under the threshold of ₹5,000 remain free of charge.
articles.insight: The introduction of a merchant fee on larger UPI transactions could impact consumer behavior and the adoption rate of digital payments in India.

articles.title: 4 days left to exhibit at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
articles.description: Last day to exhibit at Disrupt is Sept 18. 4 days left. Get your startup in front of 10,000+ founders, investors, operators and tech leaders October 13–15.
articles.summary: Startups with an exhibit at TechCrunch Disrupt 2decade-old event have until September 18 to submit, with a showcase planned for October 13-15. This gives only a narrow window for interested parties to make their pitch.
points: TechCrunch Disrupt's deadline for exhibitors is rapidly approaching, with only a handful of days left until the last day to submit.
The event promises a significant audience of more than 10,000 industry professionals, including founders, investors, and tech leaders, who are expected to attend the October 13-15 showcase.
The limited timeframe highlights the importance for startups to quickly prepare and submit their exhibits if they wish to participate in this prestigious event.
articles.insight: The time-sensitive nature of TechCrunch Disrupt's exhibitor application deadline underscores the value of prompt preparation and submission for startups aiming to make an impactful impression at one of the technology industry's most influential events.
